Per-chain sampler diagnostics

Source: R/diagnostics.R
diagnose_chains.Rd

Per-chain sampler diagnostics

Usage

diagnose_chains(sampler, max_treedepth, reference = NULL)

Arguments

sampler

a plain iterations x chains x variables array of post-warmup sampler parameters (divergent__, treedepth__, energy__, ...).

max_treedepth

the run's maximum tree depth setting.

reference

named list or data frame of available backend summaries.

Value

a base data.frame with one row per chain and columns chain, num_divergent, num_max_treedepth, and ebfmi. A diagnostic whose sampler column is absent (e.g. algorithm = "Fixed_param") is NA.
